chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Seapunk, for 21 total printed damage.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered using Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi for its 3 Block mode, followed by All Streams Flow to the Sea, trading substantial damage for some mitigation of the telegraphed attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 3 Block available from Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi and therefore accepted the full 11 incoming damage in exchange for maximizing damage and leaving Seapunk at 1 HP.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A telegraphed attack large enough to threaten lethal, but preventable by 3 Block, would have changed my choice to the defensive Thoma - Blazing Ooyoroi line.
